name: Streamer Party
summary:
It's a collection of games you can play live with your chat, designed to make viewers active participants instead of passive spectators. Right now, the game features a coffee shop where your chatters can place orders directly from your menu while you're live.

What makes Streamer Party different is that viewers can also download the game and join you directly. Even then, everything still runs through Twitch chat. The game only reads and sends chat messages. No external connections, no security concerns.

Just you, your stream, and your community playing together.
